subject: Private VPC: cordon-based patch windows & pinset safeguards
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Jared Mullins <jared@zencloud.com>, acme-platform@acme.io
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Private VPC: cordon-based patch windows & pinset safeguards

Hi Jared / Acme platform team,

We're scheduling a controlled patch for your private VPC deployment to apply the 2026Q4 runtime security fixes and a minor model-serving dependency bump. We want to run this as a cordon (node-level maintenance with staged drains) and keep your customer-facing endpoints on the warm fallback variants during the window. High-level asks: 

- Can you confirm preferred maintenance windows (options below)?
  * Option A: Tue 2026-10-26 01:00-04:00 UTC
  * Option B: Thu 2026-10-28 22:00-02:00 UTC
- Any blackout times during those windows?
- Who is the on-call for network/security at your end (we'll need an escalation contact)?

We'll pin the control-plane to the current model version for the first canary group and run a rollback rehearsal 48 hours prior. Attached: initial schedule and a cordon diagram.

Deliverables from Redwood during the window:
- Cordon & drain play executed per node group (stagger 10m).
- Canary traffic routed to pinned variant; traffic-splitting metrics visible in Console.
- Rollback trigger and automated pin reversal (30m target to full revert).

Please CC anyone else who should be part of approvals.

Thanks,
Sean
Sean Gallagher
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: patch-schedule-2026Q4.xlsx, vpc-cordon-diagram.png

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Jared Mullins <jared@zencloud.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-16T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private VPC: cordon-based patch windows & pinset safeguards

Sean — quick technical notes from runtime team: 

1) Canary groups: suggest 3 canaries (1 control-plane, 2 worker nodes) spaced 20m apart. We'll run a health probe series (30s pings + token-rate smoke) before shifting any production traffic.
2) KV cache warm-up: after patch, the model-serving runtime will cold-start the KV caches. We'll pre-seed caches on the canary nodes with the top-50 prefixes to avoid tail-latency spikes.
3) Network cordon: confirm whether cloud vendor allows BGP withdrawal per-subnet or we should use node-level iptables drains. If vendor-side BGP is available it's cleaner for the rollback.

Also: we'll need the exact CIDR ranges for the maintenance VLAN to update ACLs — can your netops provide?

-Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Principal Engineer, Serving Runtime

From: Jared Mullins <jared@zencloud.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: acme-platform@acme.io
Date: 2026-10-17T08:19:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private VPC: cordon-based patch windows & pinset safeguards

Thanks Sean/Rishi — Apologies for the delay. We can do Option B (Thu 10/28 22:00-02:00 UTC) but we have a 30-minute vendor freeze window from 23:15-23:45 UTC due to backups. Netops contact: Lila Cortez (lila.c@acme.io).

We can provide the maintenance VLAN CIDR: 10.40.128.0/22. We do not have BGP withdraw privileges in our managed colo; please plan for node-level drains (iptables + route suppression).

Two additional constraints: 
- No more than 2 consecutive worker nodes drained in the same AZ.
- We require an audit log snapshot (control-plane + network events) immediately before the first drain. SOC2 team will collect that.

I'll loop Lila in on the next mail.

—Jared

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Jared Mullins <jared@zencloud.com>, acme-platform@acme.io
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-18T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private VPC: cordon-based patch windows & pinset safeguards

Jared — got it. Thanks for the constraints and the VLAN. Lila, welcome — can you confirm the 2-node-per-AZ drain limit and share the vendor freeze window specifics (is the 23:15 snapshot managed by your backup vendor or self-triggered)?

Action items we own before Thu 10/28: 
- Redwood: run rollback rehearsal on Mon 10/26 (dry-run, no traffic) and capture runbook timings.
- Redwood: produce the audit-log snapshot step in the runbook and a one-click export hook for your SOC team.
- Acme: confirm Lila as netops point and provide any vendor contact (backup vendor).

Attaching updated schedule (small tweaks for the vendor freeze) and a draft rollback playbook (rollback-playbook-v2.md). Please review; I'll lock in the window after Lila confirms.

Thanks,
Sean

Attachments: rollback-playbook-v2.md, patch-schedule-2026Q4.xlsx

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Jared Mullins <jared@zencloud.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-19T09:41:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private VPC: cordon-based patch windows & pinset safeguards

Quick compliance note: 

- SOC2: We'll mark this maintenance window in the evidence tracker and capture the control-plane config diff. I recommend we also capture a signed change acknowledgement (simple checkbox form) from Acme's security lead before the window opens.
- Retention: confirm whether Acme needs the audit snapshot to be stored in their S3 archive (we can push a copy to a customer-owned bucket).

If Acme agrees, Kim from Redwood (me) will own the evidence export and retention for 90 days.

-Kim
Kimberly Park
Director, Security & Compliance

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Jared Mullins <jared@zencloud.com>
Date: 2026-10-20T14:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private VPC: cordon-based patch windows & pinset safeguards

All — final sign-off checklist before I lock the change calendar: 
1) Rollback rehearsal completed (Mon 10/26) — responsible: Rishi
2) Audit snapshot export hook validated — responsible: Kimberly
3) Vendor freeze acknowledged and vendor contact provided — responsible: Jared / Lila
4) Runbook reviewed and attachments accepted — responsible: Sean

Please reply with either "ACK" or any open items by EOD 2026-10-21 17:00 UTC. If all ACKs in, I'll publish the calendar entry and change ticket (JIRA-OPS-349) and notify our on-call rotation.

Thanks — LB
Lauren Bishop
Senior Manager, Customer Operations
